# What's New in TablePro 0.86.0
Sign in with a TablePro account to use your plan, see your devices and sync a team library. A license key from an earlier version moves into your account the first time the app opens.
A dropped connection keeps its rows while it reconnects, with Cancel, and every surface shows the same connection state.
Imports, exports, backups, restores and transfers share one progress sheet, and Quit, Close and Disconnect ask once about work still running.
Remote DuckDB connections can go through an SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel, SOCKS proxy or tunnel command, and now require the Token instead of secrets in ~/.duckdb.
A raw SQL filter can no longer run a second statement, and a DuckDB token no longer reaches another server that a later ATTACH names.
Sending feedback from inside the app is no longer available.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.86.0-beta.1
### Added
- A dropped connection keeps its rows and shows a reconnecting bar with Cancel, then Reconnect after 10 tries. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Settings > MCP offers Try Again when the server fails to start, and says when the port you set was in use. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Linked folders show what each scan found, and Settings > License > Team shows the team library's last refresh. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Downloading cloud-sql-proxy shows its progress with Cancel, and connecting says when it downloads. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Quit, Close and Disconnect ask once, in one alert listing the restores, imports, exports and queries still running. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - A notification when an agent session waits for your answer or its reply fails while you are elsewhere. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Plugin installs and updates show their progress with Cancel, and a failed update stays in Settings with Try Again. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Remote DuckDB connections can go through an SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel, SOCKS proxy or tunnel command. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - Sign in with a TablePro account to unlock paid features, see your devices and sync a team library. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Changed
- The connections strip, Welcome, the switcher, menus and the iOS app show one connection state, only when it needs you. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - The welcome window shows a license that needs attention and iCloud sync problems, each linking to the fix. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Notices, warnings and errors use the standard macOS look: color only on the symbol, with no tinted boxes, dots or chips. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Connection tags are edited in a token field: type a name to add or create a tag, and press Delete to remove one. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Plugins that could not load are listed in Settings > Extensions with the reason, Update, Try Again and Remove. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - On iOS, a saved row no longer shows a toast, and NULL, Default and column types use standard buttons and text. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A finished tab shows a checkmark and a failed one a red triangle, where both showed the same dot. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Imports, exports, backups, restores, transfers and copies share one progress sheet, and Escape asks before stopping. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - The MCP disconnect tool refuses while the connection has running work, unsaved changes or an open transaction. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - Remote DuckDB connections now require the Token and no longer read secrets saved in ~/.duckdb. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - etcd keys and values that are not UTF-8 show as hex, and a quoted `\xHH` in an etcd command writes that byte. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - A license key from an earlier version moves into your TablePro account the first time the app opens. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Removed
- Sending feedback from inside the app is no longer available. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Fixed
- A failed connect showed as disconnected on the connections strip, and a lost connection as failed. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - On iOS, a lost connection stopped reconnecting after one failed try. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - The toolbar lost the connection's name after a disconnect. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Cancelling a reconnect after an SSH tunnel dropped did not stop it, and the connection could come back on its own. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Try Again on a license check showed nothing when the check failed. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Pro features asked a license that could not be checked for 30 days, or was suspended, to buy a license. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Sync Now showed for iCloud problems that trying again cannot clear, such as a restricted account. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - The MCP status said the port was in use whenever the failure text happened to contain 48. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Notes from MySQL and SQLite maintenance, such as an OPTIMIZE note or an integrity check problem, were never shown. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Settings > Notifications kept showing an old permission after it was changed in System Settings. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A GitHub Copilot error showed only inside its provider sheet while the provider row said Not signed in. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A restore's progress bar never moved. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - A team library pull kept connection settings it should have removed until TablePro restarted. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Restores, comparisons and sync scripts never notified when they finished out of sight. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Quitting left a restore or backup tool running in the background. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Importing from another app now keeps the TLS, key passphrases and extra connection files that app saved. ([#4015](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4015)) - Restore Previous Values stayed enabled with nothing to restore, then only showed an alert. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - The selected connection in the sidebar showed a blank white badge when it was lost or failed. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - An export or table transfer kept running with no window after a disconnect that did not ask first. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - On iOS, the NULL button moved across the field when turned on while editing a row. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - Raw filter rows were offered on etcd, DynamoDB, Memcached, Weaviate, InfluxDB and Kafka, which cannot run them. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Loading a filter preset turned its same element rows into any element rows. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Raw SQL filters on SQL Server and Oracle failed with an invalid column error. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Changing a filter's operator kept the old Match Case setting, and Search All Rows matched case. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Duplicate Filter dropped Match Case and the element scope, and put the cursor in the wrong row. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - The cell Filter menu added a second copy of a filter that was already running. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Switching a filter row between Raw SQL and a column hid the text you had typed. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - A page turn, sort or refresh ran filter edits that had not been applied. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - A filter that could not run, such as raw SQL with a comment, loaded every row while showing as applied. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - MongoDB exports cut nested values at 10,000 characters. ([#4020](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4020)) - MQL exports lost special field names and changed numeric field order. ([#4020](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4020)) - MQL exports lost empty collections and skipped some index and validator values. ([#4020](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4020)) - MQL exports changed mixed-type fields, nested BSON values and stored nulls. ([#4020](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4020)) - Drop offered to ignore foreign key checks on DuckDB, ClickHouse, SQL Server, SurrealDB, Teradata and Beancount. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - A remote DuckDB connection that could not download the Quack extension showed a misleading error. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - Remote DuckDB connections ignored the SSL settings shown and could not trust a private CA or self-signed certificate. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - Beancount and Memcached showed Database instead of Ledger or Server once their driver loaded. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - A copied connection URL misread IPv6 hosts and dropped the settings after a database name holding # or ?. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - Saving an etcd key that ends in a zero width space or starts with a byte order mark changed a different key. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - etcd `get`, `del` and `watch` with `--prefix` could reach keys outside the prefix when it ended in some non-ASCII text. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - etcd `get "" --prefix`, and exporting the root of a connection with no key prefix, failed with "key is not provided". ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - Editing or deleting a non-UTF-8 etcd key changed a key named `<b64:…>`, and a rename saved a binary value as text. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - etcd keys starting with `--` could not be saved or deleted from the grid. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - etcd commands could run without the read-only or delete limits set by the app. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - An etcd range query with invalid page bounds could crash the app. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - SQLite, libSQL, DuckDB and Beancount cut text at a NUL character when reading or saving it. ([#4024](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4024)) - MongoDB edits and deletes could target the wrong document after reconnecting or switching databases. ([#4028](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4028)) - MCP and AI chat could not confirm a DELETE without WHERE, leaving it blocked or routed through the wrong tool. ([#4029](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4029)) - Stopping an import could misreport rollback, and opening another dialog could hide a running transfer. ([#4031](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4031)) - The iPad app on a Mac crashing when you open a connection, or add or edit one. ([#4032](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4032)) - Data dictionary exports could render names and comments as markup when Unicode characters joined punctuation. ([#4034](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4034)) - SQL Server edits could target the wrong text key, and filters or SQL exports could change Unicode or line endings. ([#4035](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4035)) - SQL Server edits on a char or varchar key could also change a row whose key differs only by characters like ß and ss. ([#4039](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4039)) - Deleting or editing a Firebase node or collection whose name starts with a combining mark changed the name without it. ([#4040](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4040)) - Editing or deleting a Databend row whose text held a NUL before digits could change a different row. ([#4041](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4041)) - A Databend table with a backtick in its name opened, edited and exported as another table. ([#4041](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4041)) - A value bound into a Databend query behind some comments or hints could land outside its quotes. ([#4041](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4041)) - Read-Only and Safe Mode treated pg_background, pg_cron and TimescaleDB calls, drop_chunks included, as reads. ([#4043](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4043)) - Safe Mode on Databend missed a DROP or other write hidden behind an optimizer hint, a comment or SETTINGS. ([#4044](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4044)) - A StarRocks query parameter stored a form feed as the letter f, or failed after a comment ending in a carriage return. ([#4044](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4044))
### Security
- A raw SQL filter could close its own parentheses and run a second statement, such as a DELETE. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - A remote DuckDB token could reach another Quack server that a later ATTACH in the same session named. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021))
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.86.0-beta.1)

# What's New in TablePro 0.85.0
Neo4j, InfluxDB 2 and 3, Qdrant, Memcached and StarRocks connections, and KingbaseES with a downloadable driver.
Two to six query results show as tabs, and the Structure tab shows columns, indexes, foreign keys and checks on one page.
Masking rules hide column values in the grid, copies, exports, the AI assistant and MCP. Table Health finds bloat and unused indexes.
Routine Debugger steps through PL/pgSQL and PL/SQL, and Live Messages watches PostgreSQL notifications, Redis channels and Kafka topics.
Imported and synced connections ask before using cloud or Kerberos sign-ins, and PostgreSQL reads ~/.pgpass only when you turn it on.
Settings > Plugins is now Settings > Extensions. A .sql-formatter.json saved by 0.83 needs exporting again with sql-formatter's key names.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.84.0
Find and Replace work in every data grid, with Match Case, Whole Words, regular expressions and a column scope.
Click a sorted header to reverse it or Option-click to add a sort key. Frozen columns sort, resize and reorder from their own headers.
A cell value with a line break or over 256 characters opens in an editor anchored to the cell.
The sidebar, Open Quickly, autocomplete and AI chat no longer stall on databases with tens of thousands of tables.
Procedures and Functions load on MySQL 5.x and MariaDB servers with many routines, and MariaDB packages open.
Save Changes has its own toolbar section, and panes switch views with native tabs.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)
